#### ETHICS AND ACCURACY

Vision AI for Good: Our commitment to transparency and ethics.
Oosto has invested hundreds of millions of dollars in refining our neural networks to reduce bias
and discrimination.
Reduce False Positives
Proven accurate even “in-the-wild” with poor camera angles and low light. Built-in controls prevent
low-quality image uploads and false matches.
Mitigate Bias
Algorithms are trained on a massive dataset of images across demographics.


Protect Privacy
Blur non-watchlisted individuals on video playback. Data encryption converts images to vectors
(including at the edge).
Protect Your Data
Build and maintain your own watchlist. Oosto never sees your data. Control user roles and
permissions. Supports GDPR compliance.
[ Learn more about Vision AI for Good ][90]

Real-world accuracy, rapid deployment, effective scale, and advanced analytics.

Algorithms are trained on a massive dataset of images across demographics.

Blur non-watchlisted individuals on video playback. Data encryption converts images to vectors

Build and maintain your own watchlist. Oosto never sees your data. Control user roles and

FaceFirst is a global leader in highly effective face matching software for retailers, hospitals,
casinos, airports, stadiums, and arenas. FaceFirst’s software leverages artificial intelligence and
human oversight to prevent violence, theft, and fraud. With FaceFirst, you can provide safer
environments for your valued customers, patients, guests, employees, and associates. We design our
patented video analytics platform to be scalable, fast, accurate, and ethical while maintaining high
levels of security, privacy, and accountability. FaceFirst is based in Austin, Texas.

# [FaceFirst Search Investigation Advantage][15]

It’s tedious to search video footage manually to identify persons of interest, but not with
FaceFirst’s visitor search capabilities. Our powerful search tools can reduce your investigation
time from weeks to minutes.

After you enroll a known offender in your custom database, the FaceFirst algorithm can find every
recent instance of that person entering all your locations. The result? A human investigation with
advanced AI confirmation that calculates past losses, plus date/time stamped evidence packaged for
law enforcement agencies and prosecutors.

[75% Reduced Theft.png]

A retailer that uses the FaceFirst search feature after each enrollment uncovered an average of from
five to 22 other thefts or incidents with the same offender before the enrollment.

cases against habitual offenders with just one click.

# System Integration & Cybersecurity for Modern Organizations

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi membantu Anda mengintegrasikan infrastruktur TI dan mengamankan aset
digital—mulai dari desain arsitektur, implementasi, hingga operasi keamanan. Secure your own future.

[ Konsultasi ][7] [ Lihat Layanan ][8]

## About Us

### Who We Are

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi adalah perusahaan **System Integrator** dan **Cybersecurity Services**
yang membantu organisasi merancang, mengintegrasikan, dan mengamankan ekosistem TI. Kami
menggabungkan keahlian infrastruktur (network, server, cloud) dengan praktik keamanan (assessment,
hardening, monitoring, incident response) agar sistem berjalan **stabil**, **terukur**, dan
**aman**.

Fokus kami adalah kemitraan jangka panjang: dari konsultasi, implementasi, hingga layanan terkelola.

System Integration
Network & Infrastructure
Security Assessment

Guardrails

## A tool this powerful
## only works if it's *trustworthy.*

Finding a person from a face is intimate. We built the rules first and the engine second. The rules
are not settings you can turn off.

Vow 01

### Your upload is never kept

Photos you search with are processed in memory and deleted when the search completes. They are never
added to the index, never used for training, never seen by staff.

Vow 02

### Public web only

We index pages anyone can open in a browser. No private accounts, no CCTV, no government or
law-enforcement databases, and no exceptions for sale.

Vow 03

### Anyone can opt out

Removing your face from Face Search AI results is free, takes one form, and applies permanently
across all plans. No account required.

Vow 04

### Abuse ends accounts

Stalking, harassment, and searches that appear to target minors are blocked by policy and by
automated review. Violations mean a permanent ban, and a report where the law requires one.

Don't want to be findable? [Remove your face from our results][13]. Free, for everyone, forever.

# Fast & reliable Real-Time mobile and server facial recognition technology

**FarFaces** is the only mobile facial recognition solution available on the market that performs
facial detection and recognition at long distances (up to 15 meters), works offline, offers
multi-channel server processing, a simple and fast set-up on your server and on a mobile device.

## Technological advantages

### LONG RANGE

Far Faces is the only mobile application for mobile devices (phones or tablets) on the market that
performs facial recognition up to 15 meters between the subject and the recognizing device.

### PRIVACY

The personal data (photo of the face) is never stored and the numerical code cannot be used for
anything other than our facial recognition app.

### MOBILITY

The main advantage of our technology is its mobile nature: no other specialized equipment or
personnel is needed (additional cameras, processors, engineers) leading to no extra costs.

## Solutions

### Farfaces mobile

Detect more than 20 faces per frame in less than one second and recognize them one by one in the
background of the app.

Recognition can work in areas with jammed and or absent mobile and Internet connection, using
pre-downloaded data of up to 12 million profiles (subject to the size of the SD card).

LOCAL SERVER POST PROCESSING AND REAL TIME RECOGNITION

video streams from multiple IP cameras, as well as analyse earlier recorded video files, which can
be used for access control, surveillance, video investigation, and other purposes.

# Custom Software Solutions

IronLogic is a leading provider of advanced security solutions and enterprise software in Sydney,
offering customized systems to meet the unique needs of businesses of all sizes. With a Security
Industry Master Licence the New South Wales Security Industry Act, we ensure our services are
compliant with industry regulations, providing clients with peace of mind and confidence in our
expertise. Our commitment to innovation and reliability has made us a trusted name in security and
software solutions. Whether you require state-of-the-art access control systems to enhance security,
logistics solutions to streamline operations, or tailored software to meet specific business
objectives, IronLogic is dedicated to delivering excellence and driving success for your
organization.

# Our Services

## Access control

Secure your business with our state-of-the-art access control systems. Featuring integration with
advanced technologies like face recognition and RFID, our solutions ensure only authorized personnel
can access your premises.

[ Learn More About Access Control ][32]

## Logistics solutions

Streamline your operations with logistics software that optimizes deliveries, fleet tracking, and
route planning. Our system supports live GPS tracking and real-time analytics, helping you achieve
up to 30% more efficiency.

[ Discover Logistics Solutions ][33]

## 24-hour gyms

Transform your gym into a 24/7 facility with our integrated access control systems. Seamlessly
compatible with leading membership software, our solutions provide secure, automated access for
members anytime.

[ Discover More ][34]

## Hands-free parking solutions

Simplify parking with our UHF RFID parking systems. Drivers can enjoy seamless entry and exit with
tags that don’t require manual scanning, all managed via advanced software for real-time monitoring.

[ Read More ][35]

## License plate recognition

Enhance your parking and security systems with our license plate recognition technology. This
solution integrates with existing CCTV systems to automate vehicle identification and improve
security.

[ Learn About LPR ][36]

## Object counting

Our object-counting software uses AI to monitor and count people, vehicles, or other objects moving
through a designated area. With advanced tailgate tracking features, it ensures security and
operational efficiency.

[ Find Out More ][37]

At IronLogic, we don’t believe in one-size-fits-all. Our tailored solutions address the specific
challenges your business faces. For instance, our access control systems can be customized to
include biometric scanning, RFID technology, or mobile access—offering the flexibility to adapt to

# Streamline Your Business Operations with IronLogic’s Innovative Tech and Software Solutions

Empowering businesses with cutting-edge tools for data management, inventory control, and financial
efficiency. From advanced route optimization that enhances delivery efficiency and reduces costs, to
robust access control systems ensuring secure and seamless entry management, IronLogic provides
tailored software solutions to automate and elevate your operations.

# Custom Software Solutions

IronLogic is a leading provider of advanced security solutions and enterprise software in Sydney,
offering customized systems to meet the unique needs of businesses of all sizes. With a Security
Industry Master Licence the New South Wales Security Industry Act, we ensure our services are
compliant with industry regulations, providing clients with peace of mind and confidence in our
expertise. Our commitment to innovation and reliability has made us a trusted name in security and
software solutions. Whether you require state-of-the-art access control systems to enhance security,
logistics solutions to streamline operations, or tailored software to meet specific business
objectives, IronLogic is dedicated to delivering excellence and driving success for your
organization.

# Our Services

## Access control

Secure your business with our state-of-the-art access control systems. Featuring integration with
advanced technologies like face recognition and RFID, our solutions ensure only authorized personnel
can access your premises.

[ Learn More About Access Control ][32]

## Logistics solutions

Streamline your operations with logistics software that optimizes deliveries, fleet tracking, and
route planning. Our system supports live GPS tracking and real-time analytics, helping you achieve
up to 30% more efficiency.

[ Discover Logistics Solutions ][33]

## 24-hour gyms

Transform your gym into a 24/7 facility with our integrated access control systems. Seamlessly
compatible with leading membership software, our solutions provide secure, automated access for
members anytime.

[ Discover More ][34]

## Hands-free parking solutions

Simplify parking with our UHF RFID parking systems. Drivers can enjoy seamless entry and exit with
tags that don’t require manual scanning, all managed via advanced software for real-time monitoring.

[ Read More ][35]

## License plate recognition

Enhance your parking and security systems with our license plate recognition technology. This
solution integrates with existing CCTV systems to automate vehicle identification and improve
security.

[ Learn About LPR ][36]

## Object counting

Our object-counting software uses AI to monitor and count people, vehicles, or other objects moving
through a designated area. With advanced tailgate tracking features, it ensures security and
operational efficiency.

[ Find Out More ][37]

# Benefits

### Solutions Designed for Your Unique Needs

At IronLogic, we don’t believe in one-size-fits-all. Our tailored solutions address the specific
challenges your business faces. For instance, our access control systems can be customized to
include biometric scanning, RFID technology, or mobile access—offering the flexibility to adapt to
your facility’s security requirements. Similarly, our route optimization tools are designed to
handle complex delivery schedules, minimizing idle time and ensuring seamless operations.

### Intelligent Route Optimization for Delivery Success

With years of experience in the tech industry, IronLogic has partnered with leading businesses to
deliver innovative solutions that make an impact. Our team’s deep knowledge spans across industries,
allowing us to craft systems like our robust inventory management tools or access control platforms
that have helped businesses achieve efficiency gains of up to 30%. By implementing our technology,
clients consistently report measurable improvements in operational outcomes.

### Future-Proof Systems Built for Growth

IronLogic’s tech and software solutions are designed with scalability and longevity in mind. For
example, our route optimization technology uses intelligent algorithms to adjust to real-world
conditions, resulting in fuel savings of up to 20% for logistics businesses. Our access control
systems offer real-time monitoring and remote management capabilities, enabling companies to adapt
to evolving security needs without costly overhauls. With IronLogic, you’re investing in
technologies that grow with your business.

# Industries We Serve

### Construction Sites

We help construction companies like WestBourne secure their worksites with state-of-the-art access
control systems, including face recognition modules. These solutions ensure that only authorized
personnel can access restricted areas, improving safety and preventing unauthorized entry.

### Office and Commercial Spaces

Clients like Wotso rely on our controllers and readers to manage access across multiple locations
seamlessly. Our systems allow for remote configuration, making it easy to adapt to changing
requirements while ensuring the security of staff and assets.

### Fitness Centers and 24-Hour Gyms

Our tailored access control systems for gyms streamline member entry, integrate with billing
systems, and include advanced features like tailgate detection to maintain security. Whether you
operate during regular hours or 24/7, we’ve got you covered.

### Retail and Parking Facilities

Our hands-free parking solutions and license plate recognition systems provide efficient traffic
management for retail centers and parking facilities. Enhance customer experience and streamline
operations with IronLogic’s innovative systems.

### Industrial and Logistics Operations

Optimize your supply chain with our logistics solutions designed to track assets, control entry and
exit points, and streamline warehouse operations. Our systems are customizable to meet the needs of
any logistics facility.

Every threat has a face. We sort them by who is watching and how much they can spend, from a lone

Use different emails, browsers, and identities for different aspects of your life.

A VPN is the bare minimum. Tor is better. Leave your phone at home when possible.

The internet does not forget. Data collected today by a "benign" entity can be sold tomorrow to a
hostile one. Assume everything is logged forever.

## Millimeter wave (mmW) solutions from Siklu by Ceragon deliver ultra-fast, cost-effective wireless
## connectivity across urban, suburban, and enterprise environments. Operating in the license-exempt
## 60 GHz (V-band) and lightly licensed 70/80 GHz (E-band) spectra, mmWave technology bypasses the

## performance, multi-gigabit speeds, and ultra-low latency.
